# Windows Simulator

> A Windows 10 desktop simulator built with React by Dawid Olko. It runs in the browser with a lock screen, draggable application windows, a start menu, a taskbar and a set of working demo applications.

## Pages

- [Home](https://windows.dawidolko.pl/): the simulated desktop

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
